notes: Report: /home/user/claude-workspace/research/families/volatility_breakout.md. 12 searches ran before the session search budget closed; ~30 pages fetched including full text of Holmberg-Lonnbark-Lundstrom (FRL 2013, crude ORB) and Mesfin (arXiv 2605.04004, 2026, MNQ walk-forward). quantifiedstrategies.com, SSRN, ScienceDirect, medium, forexfactory blocked fetches (abstract/snippet only). Headline findings: (1) raw volatility breakouts do not clear futures friction in any cost-aware 2023-2026 test (Fetna 2026: 0/225 ORB cells net-positive at $25/RT; Mesfin 2026: 11/14 OHLCV families below the 2-pt MNQ friction floor; Oxford Strat 1980-2016: Crabel stretch ORB / NR7 / 2-bar-NR all rated C, wide-range breakout rated D with PF 0.74). (2) Entering after a completed 5-min expansion bar is actively negative (T=-11.52, N=1,955); entries must be resting stops at pre-computed levels filled from 1-min data, 09:30-11:30 ET. (3) The only peer-reviewed positive threshold-breakout result (Holmberg, crude 1983-2011, open*(1+/-rho), EOD exit, no costs) has 61-71% hit rates at tight thresholds with the whole edge in the high-vol 2001-2011 decade. (4) Compression predicts expansion (inside days broke prior range 87.8% ES / 88.4% NQ in 2025) but not direction; direction must come from open-vs-prior-midpoint (67%/58% target hits on NQ) or trend filters. (5) ATR regime does not change continuation probability (<1.8pp across regimes, 6,142 ES/NQ sessions) so volatility should set size, not permission. (6) Median post-break extension is 36-43% of the prior bar range on ES/NQ, so a 0.4x-range capped target with 0.5x-range stop fits the Lucid 50% consistency and 5x$150 payout rules far better than EOD-only exits. Squeeze indicators (TTM/Bollinger/Keltner) have no credible intraday futures evidence. Candidates for backtest: VB-1 Williams open+k*range (k 0.3-0.5) conditioned on open-vs-midpoint and no wide-spread day; VB-2 ID/NR4/NR7 stretch ORB; VB-3 inside-day range-target trade; VB-4 ATR-unit breakout with 0.33-ATR stop; all micros, one attempt/day, daily loss cap $300-400, flat 15:55 ET. The family suits the "safe" configuration (steady $100-300 days) more than the "fast" one.

strategies.name: Larry Williams volatility breakout (open + k x prior-day range), NanoTrader/WH SelfInvest spec
strategies.origin: Larry Williams (Long-Term Secrets to Short-Term Trading, 1999; 1987 Robbins Cup); WH SelfInvest/NanoTrader free system
strategies.entry: Range_y = H[y]-L[y] daily. Buy stop at Open_today + 0.25*Range_y; sell stop at Open_today - 0.25*Range_y (Williams' own text uses k 0.5-0.7). First stop filled is the position. Run on 5-min (or 1-min) bars.
strategies.exit: Profit target and stop both 2x the k-range (= 0.5*Range_y) from entry; time exit 15:59 ET (21:59 CET). Williams book variant: exit first profitable open.
strategies.filters: Book variants: trade-day-of-week filters; prefer longs after a down close. None in the NanoTrader default.
strategies.parameters: k in {0.25, 0.5, 0.7}; stop/target 2x k-range (0.5x range); exit 15:59 ET; one trade/day
strategies.instruments: DAX, Dow, NASDAQ, S&P 500, CAC 40, Bund (vendor charts); TradingView audit mostly single stocks/crypto
strategies.timeframe_session: Daily range unit, intraday 5-min/1-min execution, RTH, flat 15:59 ET
strategies.claimed_performance: Vendor: 'profits variable but none negative', no numbers/costs. TradeSearcher audit of 2,036 TradingView runs: 185 with >15 trades, 10 pass quality gate, avg t 2.63 but p 0.14, robustness 18/100, 'cannot be told apart from chance'. QS SPY 1993-2026 Williams volatility-channel breakout: trend version poor; MR version 0.69%/trade, MDD 33%, PF<1.75.
strategies.prop_fit: Acceptable shape (one trade/day, bracket, flat by close). Stop 0.5x range = 25-35 ES pts in 2025 => micros only (2-4 MES). Cap target at 0.4-0.5x range for the 50% consistency rule; EOD-only exit gives fat right tail.

strategies.name: Williams breakout, mql5 Market Secrets automation (prior-range, swing-range, structure+time filters)
strategies.origin: mql5.com article series 2026 (Parts 5, 6, 8), MQL5 EAs on XAUUSD
strategies.entry: Part 5: buy level = Open + Range_y*BuyMult, sell = Open - Range_y*SellMult, detected by 1-min crossover. Part 6: range = max(|H[3d ago]-L[1d ago]|, |H[1d ago]-L[3d ago]|) (dominant swing). Part 8: longs only when last 3 daily bars form a Williams short-term swing low (bar 2 extreme, no inside/outside bars); optional TDW and time-of-day windows.
strategies.exit: Stop = entry -/+ range*StopMult; target = stop distance * RewardMult. Daily bars, multi-day holds as published.
strategies.filters: Swing-structure filter, trade-day-of-week, time-of-day; long-only in tests
strategies.parameters: BuyMult/SellMult/StopMult/RewardMult (values not disclosed); 1-2% risk per trade
strategies.claimed_performance: XAUUSD $10k, long-only, 2025: Part 5 Jan-Nov net +$6,203 (~60%); Part 6 Jan-Dec net +$4,450 (44%), win 48.39%; Part 8 Jan-Dec net +$3,711 (35%), win 54.55%. No PF/DD/trade counts/costs; gold rose ~60% in 2025 (beta).
strategies.prop_fit: Published as multi-day daily system (violates no-overnight). Convertible to intraday with a 15:55 ET exit; swing-range unit is a useful alternative volatility unit for MGC/ES/NQ.

strategies.name: Williams VBO with SMA20 trend filter and 11:30 ET entry cutoff (open-source variant)
strategies.origin: rusty_trader stratlab vbo.py (GitHub 2026, SPY/QQQ/megacaps 5-min 2021-2026); freqtrade LWBreakout (nateemma)
strategies.entry: trigger_long = Open_today + k*(H[y]-L[y]), k default 0.5; enter on first 5-min bar with high >= trigger if bar time <= 11:30 ET; long only if Open_today > SMA20(daily closes, lagged 1), short mirror. freqtrade: open + 0.66*ATR(60 bars), close-cross entry.
strategies.exit: Hold to EOD, flatten on 15:55 bar; no stop in published code (add 0.5x range or 1 ATR). freqtrade: close crossing below open - 0.15*ATR(60).
strategies.filters: SMA20 daily trend; entry cutoff 11:30 ET; one entry/day/name
strategies.parameters: k in {0.3,0.5,0.7}; cutoff in {11:00,11:30,12:00} ET; IBKR tiered + 1bp slippage
strategies.claimed_performance: Docstring cites unverified 'PF 1.15-1.35 raw, 1.35-1.60 with trend filter, Sharpe 0.85-1.25' from QS archives; result files not accessible.
strategies.prop_fit: Good shape for Lucid (one trade/day, trend-directed, morning-only entries, EOD flat). Needs a stop.

strategies.name: Holmberg-Lonnbark-Lundstrom normal-quantile threshold breakout (open x (1 +/- rho))
strategies.origin: Finance Research Letters 10 (2013); Umea University working paper ues845
strategies.entry: rho_alpha = mean + SD of log(Close/Open) x standard-normal quantile q_alpha (alpha 10%,5%,1%,0.5%,0.1%). Long filled at Open*(1+rho) if High exceeds it; short at Open*(1-rho) if Low breaks it.
strategies.exit: Close of the same day; no stop, no target; perfect fill, zero costs
strategies.filters: None (threshold estimated ex post on full sample)
strategies.timeframe_session: Daily OHLC 1983-03-30 to 2011-01-26, 6,976 days; EOD exit
strategies.claimed_performance: Full sample long alpha=1%: N 188, 61.2% winners, +0.258%/trade, p=0.0001; alpha=0.1%: N 80, 71.3%, +0.403%. 2001-2011 alpha=1% long: N 50, 80% winners, +0.516%, p=0.006; short N 64, 64.1%, +0.388%. 1992-2001 alpha=1% long: 58.1%, +0.084%, p=0.036; short n.s. Hit rate and mean rise as threshold tightens; edge concentrated in high-vol decade.
strategies.prop_fit: Mechanically ideal (known level, EOD exit) but no stop and gross of costs; crude not available 2024-26. Transfer to ES/NQ/GC with rolling 250-day rho, 5-10% quantile for trade count, stop at open, exit 15:55 ET.
strategies.data_requirements: Daily OHLC + 1-min for fills; crude 2024-2026 not available so test on ES/NQ/GC

strategies.name: Generic ATR breakout from prior close with 0.33-ATR stop (Kaufman-style / Intraday Volatility Breakout Blueprint)
strategies.origin: Perry Kaufman, Trading Systems and Methods (volatility breakout); crackingmarkets.com blueprint (2025); StockSharp ATR Range Breakout
strategies.entry: Levels = prior close +/- k*ATR (k 0.33 example; Kaufman daily k 1-3). Long above upper, short below lower. One breakout attempt per market per day.
strategies.exit: Fixed stop 0.33*ATR; exit at end of day
strategies.filters: Trade only after a narrow day / low-vol contraction with a trend filter (claimed 3x expectancy, 6x fewer trades)
strategies.parameters: ATR length unspecified (use 14); k 0.33-0.5; stop 0.33 ATR
strategies.instruments: SPY, QQQ, IWM, GLD, TLT (blog); StockSharp generic
strategies.timeframe_session: Daily ATR unit, intraday execution, EOD exit
strategies.claimed_performance: Blog: unfiltered 'not bad', filtered 3x expectancy; no win rate/PF/DD. StockSharp vendor claim ~169%/yr (ignore).
strategies.prop_fit: Small bounded loss (0.33 ATR14 on ES ~20 pts = $100/MES); one attempt/day; good micro candidate (VB-4).

strategies.name: Crabel stretch ORB and ORBP (one-sided preference with price-channel or momentum filter)
strategies.origin: Toby Crabel, Day Trading with Short Term Price Patterns and ORB (1990); S&C 1988-89 ORB series; Oxford Strat independent tests
strategies.entry: Noise_i = min(H_i-O_i, O_i-L_i); Stretch = SMA10(Noise) x multiple (1.0 Crabel, 2.0 tested). Buy stop Open+Stretch, sell stop Open-Stretch; first fill is the trade, other is the stop; no same-day reversal. ORBP: take only one side when biased (price channel: High > highest high of L days; momentum: Close > Close[L]); cancel if opposite stretch hit first.
strategies.exit: Crabel: same-day close or first profitable close. Oxford Strat: Nth-day close (1-50), stretch exit, ATR(20)x6 stop.
strategies.filters: Earlier fill better (within 10 min of open); best after inside day, NR day, hooks, ID-NR; never after a wide-spread day; S&P ORB II: wide directional first 5-min bar, cancel unfilled orders after 5-10 min
strategies.parameters: Stretch_Length 10, multiple 1.0-2.0, filter lookback 2-100, ATR stop 6x
strategies.instruments: 42 US futures (commodities, currencies, rates, equity indexes)
strategies.timeframe_session: Daily bars with intraday stop entries; 1980-2015/16
strategies.claimed_performance: Positive gross; with $50/RT 'not currently tradeable without additional rules'; rating C. Trend filters improve; longer holds preferred. Mirror wide-range-N-day pattern: net -$873,375, Sharpe -1.45, PF 0.74, CAGR -5.09%, MDD 88.3%, win 23.8%, rating D.
strategies.prop_fit: Codeable to the tick from 1-min data; stretch on ES 2025 ~10-15 pts so 1x-stretch stop $50-75/MES. ~45% both-stop days; use ORBP one-sided version with open-vs-midpoint bias.

strategies.name: NR7 + stretch ORB / NR7 + prior-day-range breakout
strategies.origin: Crabel (1990); Oxford Strat NR7 (Setup & Exit) and Price Breakout with NR7 (Connors/Raschke entry)
strategies.entry: Setup: today's range narrower than each of previous six days (NR_Length 6). Next day A: buy stop Open+Stretch (SMA10 noise x2), sell stop Open-Stretch. B: buy stop 1 tick above NR7 high, sell stop 1 tick below NR7 low; other side is the stop; no reversal.
strategies.exit: Nth-day close (1-40), stretch exit, ATR(20)x6 stop; Crabel: same-day close
strategies.claimed_performance: Without costs viable; with $50/RT 'not currently tradeable without some additional rules'; rating C both variants. QS snippet: NR4 next-day tests 60%+ in all but two, none above 70%. rusty_trader docstring (unverified): SPY NR7+200SMA+Donchian 75-77% win, PF 2.30-2.35, 3-5 day hold; its own intraday note: 87% win but PF<1 due to large losers until a stop at NR7 low is added.
strategies.prop_fit: NR7 ~15-20% of days => 3-4 setups/month/instrument; fine as safe overlay across ES/NQ/GC. Hard stop and capped target mandatory.

strategies.name: 2-bar NR (xBNR) + stretch ORB
strategies.origin: Crabel (1990) x-bar narrow range; Oxford Strat 2-Bar NR Pattern
strategies.entry: 2-day range (HH-LL of last 2 days) narrowest of any 2-day range in prior 20 days. Next day buy stop Open+Stretch, sell stop Open-Stretch (stretch = SMA10 noise x 2.0).
strategies.exit: Nth-day close (1-40), target = Target_Index x initial risk (1-10), stretch exit, ATR(20)x6 stop
strategies.claimed_performance: Rating C; degradation with $50/RT illustrated; no tables
strategies.prop_fit: Rare (~5-8% of days); use as sizing tier (2x micros) on top of VB-2

strategies.name: ID/NR4 breakout (Connors & Raschke Street Smarts)
strategies.origin: Connors & Raschke, Street Smarts (1995), building on Crabel's IDnr4
strategies.entry: Setup day is an inside day (H<H[1], L>L[1]) and NR4 (range < each of prior 3 days). Next day buy stop 1 tick above setup high, sell stop 1 tick below setup low; opposite stop is stop-and-reverse (standard interpretation of the book).
strategies.exit: Exit if not profitable within 2 days; trail stop. Lucid version: one-sided, stop at opposite extreme or 1x stretch, target prior-day high/low, flat 15:55 ET
strategies.parameters: Entry 1 tick beyond setup bar; 2-day time stop
strategies.instruments: Book examples (S&P, bonds, currencies); statistics on SPY/ES/NQ
strategies.claimed_performance: No book statistics. Quantifiable Edges SPY: 215 inside days 2001-2008 closed lower next day 54%, net -0.2%; inside days with down close (104) closed down 58%, losses 2.1x gains; edges flat after 2009. Edgeful 2025 (6 months, NY session): inside day followed by break of prior range 87.84% ES (65/74), 88.41% NQ (61/69).
strategies.prop_fit: Avoid stop-and-reverse (two losses/day on trailing DD). One-sided version with small stop/target on compressed ranges is a good many-small-green-days candidate.

strategies.name: Inside-day range-target trade with open-vs-midpoint bias
strategies.origin: edgeful.com inside-day breakout data (2025); consistent with session-midpoint statistics
strategies.entry: Yesterday inside day. If 09:30 ET open > yesterday's midpoint, long at/after open (first 1-min close above open); if below, short mirror.
strategies.exit: Target yesterday's high (long) / low (short); stop at yesterday's midpoint or 0.5x yesterday's range; flat 15:55 ET
strategies.parameters: Target = prior extreme (~0.3-0.6x prior range away); stop midpoint
strategies.instruments: ES, NQ (also TSLA, NVDA in source)
strategies.timeframe_session: NY session 09:30-16:00 ET; six months to mid-2025
strategies.claimed_performance: NQ: open above midpoint -> prior high reached 67%; open below -> prior low 58%; range broken 87.8% ES / 88.4% NQ; no P&L; N 69-74 sessions
strategies.prop_fit: Very good shape: defined target/stop both small on compressed days ($100-300/lot), high hit rate, flat by close — matches 5x$150 payout profile

strategies.name: WR7-down then NR7 next-day long bias
strategies.origin: Rob Hanna, Quantifiable Edges (2008-2009)
strategies.entry: Day1 wide-range-7 with lower close; Day2 NR7; long at Day2 close (or use as next-day long-only ORBP bias)
strategies.exit: 1, 3 or 5 days later (not a day trade)
strategies.claimed_performance: Next-day average >10x a normal day (+0.06%), 3-day >5x; high win rate; sample sizes not stated
strategies.prop_fit: Direction input only for the following day's breakout

strategies.name: TTM Squeeze (Bollinger inside Keltner, momentum histogram fire)
strategies.origin: John Carter, Mastering the Trade (2005); thinkorswim TTM_Squeeze; TradingView NA-GPT strategy
strategies.entry: BB = SMA20 +/- 2 SD; KC = EMA20 +/- 1.5 ATR20. Squeeze ON when both BBs inside KC; fire on first bar BBs exit KC; enter in direction of momentum histogram = linreg(20) of close minus avg(Donchian20 midpoint, SMA20).
strategies.exit: Histogram fades toward zero; or 21-SMA cross (TradingView long-only variant)
strategies.claimed_performance: No credible intraday futures backtest. QS Bollinger squeeze: 'doesn't do particularly well for any asset'; PEP 1975-2026 12.5% CAGR vs 14.8% B&H, 61% exposure, MDD 26%. GitHub PSX ensemble 66.7% win/106.7% 10yr (not applicable).
strategies.prop_fit: Compression flag only (e.g., require 5-min squeeze ON at 09:30-10:00 before stretch ORB); not a primary entry

strategies.name: Bollinger bandwidth vs ATR squeeze (bbs = 2*SD20/(1.6*ATR20) < 1) breakout
strategies.origin: ProRealCode screener; luxalgo volatility percentile convention
strategies.entry: Squeeze when 2*SD(close,20)/(1.6*ATR20) < 1 for several bars (or bandwidth 252-bar percentile < 20); breakout = close outside Bollinger band in direction of trend filter (SMA50 > SMA200)
strategies.exit: Not specified (use ATR stop / EOD)
strategies.parameters: 20-period SD, ATR20 x 1.6, percentile lookback 252, <20 compression, >80 stress
strategies.claimed_performance: None quantitative
strategies.prop_fit: Compression flag only

strategies.name: Keltner channel breakout (EMA20 +/- 2 ATR14, 5-min)
strategies.origin: Keltner/Raschke; StockSharp Keltner Channel Breakout; mql5 EAs
strategies.entry: Long on close above EMA20 + 2*ATR14; short below EMA20 - 2*ATR14 on 5-min bars
strategies.exit: Price crosses back through EMA20, or stop
strategies.instruments: Vendor: stocks, EURUSD; nothing on ES/NQ/GC

strategies.name: Volatility-regime classifier days (VVG): fade vs follow the opening move
strategies.origin: Mesfin 2026 (arXiv 2605.04004) and companion Mesfin 2026b
strategies.entry: Fires (~4.4% of days) when |first-30-min return|, |overnight gap| and first-bar volume deviation (20-day baseline) are all top-tercile of expanding-window distributions. Reversal = fade opening direction; continuation = follow; close-fade at 15:30 ET
strategies.exit: Fixed horizon (bars); net of 2 pts
strategies.claimed_performance: Reversal: N 35, net +13.49 pts, T=1.26, 2023 -11.45 / 2024 +8.35 / 2025 -22.76. Continuation: -17.49 pts, T=-1.64, 2023 -49.00 / 2024 +37.00 / 2025 +18.76. Days are distinct (25.6bp next-day spread, 77.6% peak-reversal) but no fixed direction survives.
strategies.prop_fit: Regime flag only: reduce size / apply daily loss cap on top-tercile gap and first-30-min days

strategies.name: ATR / VIX / realized-vol percentile regime filter (sizing overlay)

strategies.entry: Overlay: contracts = daily risk budget / (stop in ATR units x ATR14 x $/pt); skip days with yesterday's range > 1.5x ATR14 (Crabel wide-spread rule); reduce size when overnight gap > 1x ATR14 or VIX 252-day percentile > 80

strategies.filters: VIX percentile (Yahoo ^VIX), ATR14/close percentile, range/ATR, gap/ATR; percentile = share of last 252 readings <= today's
